comment: Batch-refresh step 6 S6-9a (register R-91; 批次标识 R-65): the G9 frozen-candidate acceptance matrix of the step-6 design section 9.5. ONE list read by the real-DB cases module (stock-preparation-g9-acceptance-realdb.cases.ts: every realDb id must have exactly one registered case) and by the runner (scripts/ops/stock-prep-g9-frozen-candidate.mjs: every realDb id must print one '[G9] <id> ok' line in the CI log of the frozen sha). Values-free: ids and words only.

u03InertForeignSteps.reason: G9-U03 drills these pull steps' tiers like every route (below the pull tier 403 with nothing written and no audit row; at or above it admitted), but sends the tenantless and cross-tenant callers only INERT requests (an empty body, made-up job ids): the S3A real stack configures no large lane, so no real expansion / apply job id of this tenant exists to address, and a valid start from a foreign caller would leave background work running past the case. Their tenant derivation is the dry-run's own (resolveOperatorValueScope), which the drill does reach on pull.dry-run, pull.apply and pull.reconcile with valid bodies.

u03BodyValidationStops.reason: G9-U03 refuses any NON-INERT foreign call (the real id, the bogus id and every steering carrier) that stops at body validation instead of reaching the tenant gate or the scoped read, unless it is listed here. The list is EXACT both ways: an unlisted stop and a listed stop that no longer happens both turn G9-U03 red. Every entry is the BODY carrier: the route reads a CLOSED body (an unknown key, here tenantId, is refused before any IO), so that carrier cannot reach the gate on that route by construction; the query and params carriers of the same route do reach it and are refused there.

manual.what: the section 7.5 drill proper, criterion restated 2026-11-13 (register R-91): a pre-step-6 build (the parent of migration 106's first commit) and the candidate, each on a twin clone of a database migrated by the candidate and carrying the drill artifacts (the G9-U07 ones, the B-22 shape, an open hold, a claim-active continuation and the G9-S66-U07 open repair run); every blocking stop query non-zero, so the rollback is refused until they read 0 (the operator rule; the old build is not expected to refuse writes); export refused on every artifact project left unsettled, in both builds; the old build writes no row the candidate would not; after clearing, the old build answers as the candidate does (runner: --old-build-drill prints the steps and the full criterion)

the pilot pages that exist, in a real browser on a deployment built from the frozen sha: the project board, the readiness and enable panel with the enable flow, the post-enable view and the pull-confirmation recovery card. The census, remnant and sheet-repair surfaces have no page at the frozen candidate; they are API plus runbook only (pilot runbook sections 5 and 6), so this item does not cover a page for them

the plan section 9 mutant list (step-4 section 19, step-6 section 11, BI section 11.4), each turning its named case red on a scratch copy, restored byte-identical. Of these lists only step-6 section 11 is in git; the plan section 9, step-4 section 19 and BI section 11.4 lists are not, and some named cases do not exist at the frozen candidate, so the item cannot be met literally. It is satisfied in substance per coordinator T-ruling R-P2-5 (Ratified-by-default-2026-11-13; register R-91 [53]), with the residual gaps registered there
the positive pilot-enable leg on a real deployment built from the frozen sha, values-free evidence

tenantless platform admin can preview and apply into a named tenant while the tenant-claim flag is off — ruled 2026-11-11: option A — the flag is a pilot-enable precondition; the legacy path stays for non-pilot use while the flag is off
manual.where: PRE-EXISTING product behaviour, not changed by S6-9a: plugins/plugin-integration-core/lib/http-routes.cjs requireTableActionAccess (the legacy integration:* branch, :1552-1578) returns before the operator scope, so a tenantless integration:admin naming a tenant (query or params tenantId) previews AND applies into that tenant's governed stock-prep sheet; assertVerifiedTenantClaim (:1780) closes it only when MULTITABLE_STOCK_PREP_TENANT_CLAIM_REQUIRED is exactly 'true' (default off). G9-U03 PINS the measured outcome under this id (flag off: dry-run 200 with a minted token, apply 200 written 1; flag on: 403 OPERATOR_SCOPE_TENANT_REQUIRED on every carrier, nothing written) — pinned, never certified: no G9 PASS covers it. RULED 2026-11-11 (owner, register R-91, option A): no change to the legacy branch and none for non-pilot projects; the flag being on is a pilot-enable precondition, enforced by pilot readiness v6's tenant_claim_required (lib/stock-preparation-pilot-readiness.cjs), which G9-PE holds (flag off: the enable 409 with that id the only failing one). It gates the enable only: removing the flag after a pilot is enabled reopens the path on that pilot sheet, so the pilot runbook forbids it; flipping the flag on the customer site is a separate owner gate at install time, after confirming the daily scheduled pull uses a tenant-bound token.
